full_description:
Learn how to use Gemini and Google Workspace together to improve everyday professional work.

This practical Gemini & Google Workspace AI course teaches effective AI instructions, multimodal inputs, professional email communication, document drafting, spreadsheet analysis, presentation creation and information research.

Develop hands-on experience using Gemini with Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides and Google Drive.

Learn to draft and review emails, create structured business documents, understand files, prepare spreadsheet formulas, interpret datasets, build charts and develop professional presentations.

Explore Gemini Deep Research, Gemini Notebook, document-grounded answers, source verification and cross-document comparison.

Learn how reusable instructions and Gemini Skills can support consistent business tasks, subject to verified feature availability.

Understand data permissions, AI limitations, safe file handling and human verification requirements.

Build a professional Google Workspace AI Productivity Suite containing an analyzed spreadsheet, a business presentation, a professional document, an email workflow and a cited research briefing.

The programme emphasizes practical workplace skills, reliable outputs, privacy-aware collaboration and reusable processes rather than outdated model specifications or advanced API engineering.

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Craft clear, context-rich task instructions and multimodal prompts for Google Gemini without relying on memorized specs.
Draft, polish, rewrite, and summarize professional communications in Gmail with verified recipient context and human approval.
Create well-structured business proposals, executive summaries, and reports in Google Docs using iterative AI editing.

Machine learning engineers looking for algorithmic architecture, mathematical foundations, or model training.
Individuals expecting automated end-to-end execution without human review, editing, and verification.

modules.module_purpose: Master core generative AI principles, the Gemini ecosystem, multimodal prompting, responsible AI practices, and output verification without relying on fixed model specs.
learning_objectives: Navigate the Gemini app interface and understand the Google Workspace AI ecosystem.
Craft explicit, context-rich task instructions specifying objective, constraints, and output formats.
Process multimodal inputs (text, images, documents) responsibly and identify file handling limits.
Detect model hallucinations, output variability, and implement systematic fact-checking procedures.
Apply Google account privacy controls, data sharing boundaries, and human-in-the-loop oversight.

faq.question: What is Gemini & Google Workspace AI?
faq.answer: Gemini & Google Workspace AI is a comprehensive 4-week, 32-hour practical certification course teaching professionals how to leverage Google Gemini across Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive. It focuses on writing, spreadsheet analysis, executive presentations, source-grounded research, and reusable business workflows.

faq.question: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The course starts from foundational generative AI concepts and clear prompt drafting before advancing into spreadsheet analysis and multi-app workflows. Anyone with basic computer and internet literacy can succeed.

faq.question: What is the course duration and fee?
faq.answer: The course runs for 4 Weeks with 32 instructional hours (8 hours per week: 4 hours live interactive instruction plus 4 hours supervised studio lab). The tuition fee is exactly ₹4,900 plus applicable 18% GST (totaling ₹5,782), adhering to our transparent Truth in Pricing policy.

faq.question: Do I need programming knowledge?
faq.answer: No. The course requires absolutely zero programming, coding, or technical engineering knowledge. It focuses on end-user productivity, business prompt engineering, and native Google Workspace features.

faq.question: Will I learn Gemini for Gmail?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 02 covers drafting client emails, refining tone, summarizing lengthy email threads, extracting action items, and drafting follow-ups, with a mandatory human sign-off protocol before sending.

faq.question: Does the course cover Google Docs and Drive?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn to draft executive reports, proposals, and SOPs in Google Docs, and use Gemini in Google Drive to search files semantically, synthesize cross-document insights, and audit access permissions.

faq.question: Will I learn AI-assisted spreadsheets?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 03 teaches you how to structure tables, generate formulas, clean messy records, and calculate business KPIs in Google Sheets using the synthetic 'Sales & Customer Enquiry Performance' dataset.

faq.question: Does it include formulas and business charts?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, conditional logic (IF, COUNTIF), and business KPI calculations, alongside building bar and line charts to visualize trends.

faq.question: Will I learn to create Google Slides presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn to translate business reports into structured presentation outlines, format native editable slides, embed linked Google Sheets charts, and author executive speaker notes in Google Slides.

faq.question: What is Gemini Notebook?
faq.answer: Gemini Notebook is Google's source-grounded research notebook (historically known as NotebookLM). It allows you to upload PDFs, Docs, web links, and transcripts to generate document-grounded answers with verifiable inline citations.

faq.question: Does the course include Deep Research?
faq.answer: Yes. The course covers the principles and multi-step investigation methodologies of Gemini Deep Research, subject to feature availability across different account tiers, with equivalent structured research methods provided.

faq.question: What are Gemini Skills?
faq.answer: Gemini Skills are Google's framework for specialized, reusable AI instructions and custom workflows tailored to recurring workplace tasks, such as executive memo drafting or monthly data summarization.

faq.question: Are Gems being replaced by Skills?
faq.answer: Yes. Google is transitioning Gems to Skills across account tiers: personal Google accounts in late 2026, Workspace business/enterprise accounts in March 2027, and education accounts in June 2027. We teach both the transition and timeless prompt frameworks.

faq.question: Do I need a paid Google AI or Workspace plan?
faq.answer: No. Standard free Google accounts or standard organizational Google Workspace accounts are fully sufficient for all mandatory coursework. We provide equivalent workflows for any advanced feature with tier restrictions.

faq.question: Can Gemini access all my Drive files and Gmail messages?
faq.answer: No. Gemini only accesses files and messages that the signed-in user has explicit permission to view, governed by Google Workspace administrative settings, connected service authorizations, and user privacy controls.

faq.question: Will I learn AI output verification?
faq.answer: Yes. Independent verification is a cornerstone of this course. You will learn rigorous formula auditing in Sheets, fact-checking protocols, inline citation verification in Gemini Notebook, and hallucination detection.

faq.question: What practical portfolio projects are included?
faq.answer: You will build the 5-component Google Workspace AI Productivity Suite: (1) AI-Assisted Business Spreadsheet, (2) Gemini-Assisted Business Presentation, (3) Business Document & Editorial Review, (4) Professional Gmail Email Workflow, and (5) Source-Verified Business Research Brief.

faq.question: Does the course teach Gemini API programming?
faq.answer: No. Gemini API programming, Python scripting, function calling, and model fine-tuning are deliberately excluded. This course is strictly designed for business productivity and office operations.

faq.question: Is this an official Google certification?
faq.answer: No. This is an independent professional certification issued by Nova Skills based on rigorous, practical portfolio evaluation. Nova Skills is an independent educational institution.

faq.question: How is this different from the ChatGPT for Work course?
faq.answer: Course 44 (ChatGPT for Work) focuses on OpenAI's ChatGPT, Advanced Data Analysis (Python execution), Canvas, and custom GPTs. Course 45 focuses specifically on Google Gemini, native Google Workspace apps (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive), Gemini Notebook, and Gemini Skills.

faq.question: What career applications can I explore?
faq.answer: Graduates apply these practical skills in roles such as AI-Assisted Office Productivity Specialist, Google Workspace Assistant, Business Documentation Assistant, Marketing Reporting Coordinator, and AI Productivity Freelancer.
